subject: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode & compliance next steps (HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2)

Hi Jordan / Sofia  

Thanks again for taking the time today  great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move the evaluation forward.

Recap (what I heard)
- You're planning to surface PHI in the product flows and need HIPAA coverage/BAA, plus SOC 2 evidence for your internal audit.
- Requirements: audit logging for all API calls, encryption at rest + in transit, key management (customer-managed KMS preferred), and the ability to prove separation of customer data for audits.
- You also mentioned potentially needing network isolation / VPC peering if penetration testing or auditors require network-level controls.

Deployment mode guidance (high level)
- Hosted API: Fastest path; we can add protections and sign a BAA for certain hosted customers. However, for production PHI-heavy workloads we generally recommend a more isolated option.
- Redwood Dedicated (recommended): Dedicated GPU pools and tenant isolation (data plane separation). We support BAA signing, audit logs retention, and can provide SOC 2 evidence. This tends to be the best balance of speed + compliance for customers who cannot do on-prem.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): Recommended if you need full control over network, cannot accept any external shared infra, or auditors require on-premise hosting.

Attachments I'm including: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), and a draft BAA for your legal team to review. Also attaching a sample network diagram template so we can map peering.

Next steps / asks
1) Please confirm whether you want us to scope for Dedicated vs Private. If Dedicated, we can give an initial sizing + price range.
2) Can you share any auditor requirements (e.g., retention windows, pen-test schedule)?
3) I'll loop in our security lead (Neha) to set up a security deep-dive / architecture review next week.
4) Procurement contact  cc them into the thread when ready; we'll send a proposal + BAA signature request.

Proposed times for a security call: Wed 5/26 10:00 :00 PDT or Thu 5/27 9:00 :00 PDT. If neither works, suggest times that do.

Thanks  I'll follow up with the requested artifacts right after this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks Jordan  answered inline and attached the artifacts: 

1) Hosted API + BAA: technically possible for some customers, but we generally recommend Redwood Dedicated for full-PHI production workloads. Hosted with BAA is typically acceptable for lower-risk PHI or limited-scope pilots where network isolation is not required. For your claimed scope (claims + patient identifiers) we recommend Dedicated or Private.

2) Ballpark (monthly): Dedicated clusters for your throughput typically start around $12k $25k/month depending on model, batching profile, and latency SLOs. I asked Dylan (cc'd) to provide a more detailed sizing + pricing range after we confirm model and traffic profile.

3) SOC 2: attached is our most recent SOC 2 Type II (redacted).

4) KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS for key rotation; Neha will cover the details in the security call and share our KMS architecture note.

Attachments included again here. If you want a fully redacted package we can produce auditor-friendly artifacts (control narratives, test coverage) under NDA.

Proposed times for the security deep-dive: Wed 5/26 10:00 9:45 PDT (confirmed for us) or Thu 5/27 9:00 9:45 PDT. Which works best for your team?

Next steps: once we lock the time, Neha will send an agenda + pre-read checklist so your security and audit folks can prepare. Dylan will follow up with a pricing strawman after the call.

Best,
Marissa

- Penetration test cadence and how we coordinate scoping for customer-led tests.

Proposed call time: Wed 5/26 10:00 :45 PDT (happy to hold). I've created a short pre-read and questionnaire here: https://redwood-secure.example.com/pre-reads/acme-compliance-checklist (access: acme-guest).
